title: Rigify
summary: Auto-rigging that ships with Blender: add a human or animal meta-rig, generate a control rig with DEF- deform bones, skin meshes to it.
useWhen: A humanoid or animal mesh needs a skeleton, weights and animation in Blender before it goes to Godot as a skinned .glb, and a hand-built armature would take too long.
avoidWhen: A prop with one or two moving parts, or a character that already has a rig: a plain bpy armature is simpler.
